head: Setomi lifting log app turns your PDF or photo plan into a workout log
dek: Setomi reads a lifting plan you already have, from a PDF, a spreadsheet, a photo or a note, and lets you log it set by set on iPhone and Apple Watch. It costs $1.99 once, with no subscription and no account.
details: The app shows what it read from your plan so you can fix any lift before saving. It has a rest timer on the lock screen and Dynamic Island, a library of about 480 lifts, and on Apple Watch you log sets with taps and the Digital Crown. You can export your workout journal as a PDF, CSV or JSON for a coach. It came out on 12 November from developer Dylan McCoy and was #22 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 13 November.
where: iPhone and Apple Watch, App Store, $1.99
means: If you follow a written lifting program from a coach or a PDF, you can log it without typing every exercise in by hand.
todo: Check that your plan's file type is one it reads (PDF, .xlsx, CSV, notes or a photo) before you buy.
thumb_words: SETOMI TURNS YOUR PLAN INTO A LOG
